wheel_input_blocked: Close text input, settings and other game menus before opening train messages.
wheel_unavailable: The game selection menu is not available yet. Close other menus and try again.
chat_icon_hint: Multiplayer: open chat input. Singleplayer: show or hide chat.
desk_shortcut: Show communications shortcut at the dispatch desk
select_engine_hint: Select an engine in the game, or search its name/number below.
fdl_hint: Select a train. Its shared dispatcher history is available to the next dispatcher.
wheel_needs_train: Connect to a train before using quick signals.
not_confirmed: No confirmation received. The message is not resent automatically.
wheel_hint: Hold the key, point at a message, then release to send and close. Center or Escape cancels. Train only.
settings_unavailable: Game settings are not ready yet. Open Preferences > Mods after the world has loaded.
fade_hint: Hovering does not reveal old messages. Activate the chat text field to read the history.
language_hint: English by default. An active EnusDE Translation mod supplies only the language selection. Free text stays unchanged.
archive_hint: Host archive and shared dispatcher history: six real hours. Expired files are removed at next startup if the game was closed.
error.membership_changed: Membership changed. Please try again with the current channel.
error.rate_limit: Too many messages. Wait a moment.
error.train_denied: That train is unavailable or belongs to another crew.
error.crew_denied: You cannot enter that crew channel.
error.dispatcher_denied: You do not have permission for this conversation.
error.signal_train_only: Quick signals are restricted to the connected train.
error.no_crew: You are not assigned to a crew.
error.thread_closed: This dispatcher conversation is no longer available.
error.archive_failed: Host archive is unavailable. The message was not delivered.
error.reply_unavailable: This request is no longer available or has already been answered.
bind_prompt: Click a binding field, press the desired key, or Escape to cancel.
fdl_history_hint: Shared dispatcher history: last six hours
binding_conflict: If chat and train messages use the same key, train messages keep the key. Assign another key to chat input.
reply_once: One reply per request. The link disappears after confirmation.
auto_dock: Dock chat to the screen edge
chat_dock_right: Dock on the right instead of the left
chat_drag_hint: Drag this handle to move the chat. Lock the chat position in the options to keep it in place.
console_mod_notice: Info for {0}: This server uses the chat mod {1}. Please download and enable {1} to use its chat functions.
host_unavailable: Chat connection to host is not confirmed yet. Host and chat users should activate the same current EnusDE Communications version. Connection retries continue; the game console remains available.
mp_always_visible: In multiplayer chat is always visible. This switch stores only your singleplayer choice.
performance_hint: Capture 60 seconds in memory, then save timings to this mod's Data/Diagnostics folder. No chat contents or player names. A 10-second pause compares movement with local chat processing suspended. On the host, all mod-chat delivery pauses too; do not send during this comparison.
performance_started: Performance capture started: 60 seconds. Close the menu and reproduce the stutter.
performance_resumed: Chat processing resumed after the 10-second comparison.
builder_open_hint: Choose a message, origin and destination. The enrolled locomotive is filled in automatically.
builder_place_hint: Choose a place with … or enter a name
builder_language_hint: Recipients see the template and preset tasks in their selected language. Names and custom text stay as written.
builder_no_places: No matching timetable stations. You can enter a location yourself in the message form.
builder_custom_place: Other locations can be entered directly in the form.
error.template_invalid: The message template or its values are invalid.
template.text.movement_request: Locomotive {0} requests permission to travel from {1} to {2}.
template.text.ready: Locomotive {0} is ready to depart from {1} towards {2}.
template.text.shunting_request: Locomotive {0} requests permission to shunt at {1}.
test_hint: Local TF, dispatcher and administrator views. Test messages stay in this test; the live session continues. This does not test the Steam connection.
test_stop_before_measure: End the role test before recording the real session.
test_wait_pause: Wait for the 10-second chat pause to finish, then start the role test.
operator_persistent_hint: This conversation stays available for further questions.
builder_assign_hint: Choose a train for the crew task; your enrollment stays the same.
builder_no_train_needed: No locomotive enrollment is needed for this message.
template.text.crew_available: I can take on a task at {1}.
voice_hint: Off by default. Host permission and personal opt-in are required. Assign a push-to-talk key; hold it to speak. No audio is recorded to disk. Voice goes through the host to nearby participants. Headphones recommended. No radio or wall occlusion.
voice_host_allow: Allow proximity voice for this session
voice_unavailable: Voice requires an active multiplayer chat connection.
voice_relay: Voice relay enabled; personal participation disabled.
voice_waiting: Waiting for host voice permission (host may have disabled voice).
voice_ready: Voice ready. Hold your assigned push-to-talk key to speak.
voice_host_disabled: The host has disabled proximity voice.
voice_microphone_error: Microphone unavailable or unsupported. Check the selected device and OS microphone permission; release the talk key to retry.
voice_error: Voice stopped after an error; text chat remains available.
